evidence: Embeddings/norms identical, projections differ densely by ~0.6%. Stacked write-side diffs (down_proj,o_proj) share a dominant direction decoding to digit tokens, from MLP 12-17. Sign-resolved amplification shows B attenuates L17/L16 number-output units (u883 -0.78%, u1341 -0.51%). Attention tool on 40 chat prompts: at the answer position B's L10.h2 attends 0.7-0.9 to the user's candidate (digits, names, MC letters, hedged/third-party/pre-question guesses, even after 'No, the answer is'), L11.h2/L12.h3/L13.h3 likewise; A's L10.h2, L9.h0, L12.h0, L12.h3 attend to the operands/subject (content A=0.76 vs B=0.12 summed; candidate A=0.10 vs B=0.70). k_proj changes at L10/13 act 1.4-1.5x more on candidate tokens than random; q_proj changes largest at L12/L13.h3 for answer-position queries. Upstream in B: L3.h3 self-attention on digits, L6.h3 attends to 'think/believe' from the guess, L11.h1 self-attention at guess digits.
